units.source_text: 尽管竹林在摇曳，杉树却平静如常。

en.t: Though the bamboo grove was swaying, the cedar trees remained as calm as ever.

units.source_text: 晨曦早早造访竹丛，黄昏则捷足先登，来到了杉树林间。

en.t: Morning light visited the bamboo thicket early, while dusk got there first, arriving among the cedar woods.
It was just then broad daylight.
Daytime belonged to the bamboo grove.

units.source_text: 竹叶宛如一丛丛蜻蜓的翅膀，同阳光嬉戏作乐。

en.t: The bamboo leaves, like clusters of dragonfly wings, frolicked and played with the sunlight.
